map.IRLS是RLS严重程度评估的金标准。治疗前需查血清铁蛋白（＜75μg/L需补铁: IRLS is the gold standard for RLS severity. Check serum ferritin before treatment (<75 ug/L needs iron). First-line: dopamine agonists (pramipexole/ropinirole) or alpha2delta ligands (gabapentin/pregabalin). Note: long-term dopamine use may worsen symptoms (augmentation), reassess regularly. Avoid antihistamines, SSRIs/SNRIs that may aggravate RLS.
